claim_tested: Which UV-DDB subunit contacts DNA and the lesion
key_finding: DDB1 0 atoms within 5 A of DNA, closest 27.58 A, 31.93 A from the 6-4PP lesion; DDB2 70-81 atoms within 4 A, 24 atoms within 4.5 A of the lesion via Lys168, Pro191, Gly192, Trp236, Trp239, Gln372, His373
context: hsDDB1 + drDDB2 + 14/16 bp lesion duplex, in vitro crystal
confidence: High. Limitation: DDB2 is zebrafish in this construct

claim_tested: Does DDB1 contact DNA in the assembled CRL4(DDB2) ligase
key_finding: DDB1 min distance 25.40-28.06 A with 0 contacts in 4A08, 4A09, 4A0A, 4A0K, 4A0L; in 4A0K DDB1 contacts CUL4A (60 atoms) and DDB2 (53 atoms) but neither DNA strand (29.54 / 28.06 A)
context: CPD and AP-site duplexes, holo CRL4A and CRL4B ligases
confidence: High for the contact census. Limitation: 4A0K/4A0L are 5.9 and 7.4 A resolution

claim_tested: Is the single observed DDB1-DNA contact real
key_finding: DDB1 chain A has 7 atoms within 4 A of DC2 of DNA chain J (Arg129, Leu197, Arg198), but chain J belongs to the second heterodimer (DDB2 chain D, 2.82 A) while DDB1 A's own duplex (G/H) is 27.06 A away. Lattice contact at a blunt duplex end
context: Two complexes per asymmetric unit, lowest-resolution crystal of the series
confidence: High that this is packing. Limitation: no independent test of the contact

claim_tested: Does the result hold with fully human DDB2
key_finding: DDB1 27.17 and 28.13 A from DNA, 0 contacts; human DDB2 61-65 atoms within 4 A. Removes the zebrafish-DDB2 caveat

claim_tested: Does DDB1 contact nucleosomal DNA in a chromatin context
key_finding: With 145 bp of alpha-satellite DNA present, DDB1 is 26.54-27.74 A away with 0 contacts in all 5 maps; DDB2 makes 50-60 contacts
context: UV-DDB on reconstituted nucleosomes bearing 6-4PP or AP sites
confidence: Medium-high. Limitation: 3.9-4.8 A resolution, side-chain placement approximate

claim_tested: Subunit assignment of lesion recognition on nucleosomes
key_finding: 'the DDB2 subunit of UV-DDB specifically recognizes the cyclobutane pyrimidine dimer lesion at this position on the nucleosome'
context: Cellular and reconstituted human UV-DDB-nucleosome complexes
confidence: High, independent group and newer data

claim_tested: Does DDB1 contact DNA with a different DCAF
key_finding: In CRL4(CSA)-Pol II, DDB1 is 36.52-40.30 A from DNA with 0 contacts; in 7OPC it makes 129 atom contacts with CSA/ERCC8 and 3 with CUL4A
context: Transcription-coupled repair complex on a Pol II transcription bubble
confidence: High. DDB1's DNA-avoidance is not DDB2-specific

claim_tested: Which subunit is mutated in DNA-binding-deficient XP-E patients
key_finding: 'No mutations were found in the cDNA of the 127-kDa subunit'; 'p48 is required for DNA binding activity'; K244E and R273H are DDB2 changes
context: Three Ddb-negative XP-E patient cell strains, cDNA sequencing plus insect-cell overexpression
confidence: High. This is the reference currently cited for DDB1 GO:0003677, and it argues against that annotation

evidence_type: computational mapping of mutant phenotype onto structure
claim_tested: Do the XP-E DNA-binding mutations sit on a DDB2 or a DDB1 surface
key_finding: DDB2 Lys244 is 4.15 A from DNA (6th percentile of DDB2 residues); DDB2 Arg273 is 21.40 A away and UniProt annotates it as a DDB1/CUL4A interaction defect; DDB1's closest residue is 27.17 A
confidence: High. Limitation: single structure for the per-residue mapping, though the contact set was intersected across 4 human-DDB2 structures

claim_tested: Is damaged-DNA binding an activity of DDB1 alone
key_finding: 'DNA damage binding activity copurified with polypeptides of 124 and 41 kDa'; 'p124 and p41 are subunits of a heterodimeric protein'. Activity measured on the heterodimer, never on p124 alone
confidence: High for what was measured. It cannot assign the activity to a single subunit

claim_tested: Published subunit assignment for lesion contact
key_finding: 'the DDB2/XPE subunit is responsible for the interaction, which induces flipping out of the two affected bases into a binding pocket'
confidence: Review-level orientation, consistent with the computed contacts

claim_tested: Sequence-feature support for a DDB1 DNA-binding element
key_finding: DDB1 has no DNA-related feature and no XP variant; its regions are 'Interaction with CDT1' 2-768 and 'Interaction with CUL4A' 403-706. DDB2 carries 'Photolesion recognition 334-336', which matches the computed FQH lesion contact exactly
confidence: Database-level, but independently reproduced by the structural computation

claim_tested: Basis of DDB1's IDA damaged-DNA-binding annotation
key_finding: 'DDB1-CUL4B(DDB2) E3 ligase specifically binds to mononucleosomes ... containing cyclobutane pyrimidine dimers or 6-4 photoproducts'. Binding assayed for the assembled ligase
confidence: High for the complex. Supports contributes_to on DDB1, not enables
